designDetails.silhouette: One lean controlled Drone: intact long smooth eyeless dome under a compact neural helmet, narrow rib cage and waist, two long arms, two digitigrade legs, four readable dorsal pipes and one continuous segmented spear tail. Helmet, two temporal clamps and spinal cable remain compact enough that the Xenomorph silhouette dominates.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale bone organic carapace; cool ash-gray and gray-beige biomechanical recesses; restrained translucent rose-taupe soft tissue; dark mouth and joint cavities; wet highlights and metallic ivory/silver teeth. Neural hardware remains industrial gunmetal, cable insulation remains near-black and indicators remain tiny amber points.
designDetails.surface: Re-author every rib, tendon, dorsal pipe, limb plate and tail segment. Organic surfaces stay wet and biomechanical rather than chalk-white, crystalline or snowy. Helmet plates, clamp junctions and the insulated cable must remain visibly manufactured and may not dissolve into the pale shell.
designDetails.anatomy: One intact eyeless elongated head with telescoping inner jaw, one narrow ribbed torso, exactly two clawed arms, two digitigrade legs, four dorsal pipes and exactly one complete spear-tipped tail.
